elements.texte:
[cheerful] The data team is auditing the database before the new version of the website.

Every customer and every order must appear in the audit, even with no match.

For this, we get the customers’ first and last names from the customers table,

And each order’s number from the orders table.

But two customers haven’t ordered anything, and one order has no customer.

So we need to combine the two tables without leaving out any row, on either side.
